title: Native verification credit admits the shared source_id (E3 increment 1)
outcome: Native registered verification accepts the complete shared source_id, compares equal endpoints and live state with local changes allowed, and preserves stored history
acceptance: Native registered verification input and post_run accept and retain the complete source_id object returned by the shared source owner, using the agreed closed TermAl wire.
Native verification matching and live currency compare the whole source_id: equal before and after endpoints qualify with local changes allowed; a changed identity does not qualify.
Validation of new shared verification submissions is separate from validation of stored records; unsupported string declarations and shared cross-item binding are refused explicitly.
Historical verification records keep their canonical byte shape, identifiers, links and interpretation; import preserves them without a durable-row conversion.

Focused tests cover equal clean and dirty shared identities, changed identities, closed wire and malformed submissions, historical byte and import preservation, late-registration chronology, explicit unsupported routes and bounded agent receipts; the exact reviewed candidate passes the required FULL gate.

completion.summary: Delivered and landed native shared-source verification: full closed input/post_run identity, equality and live currency including equal dirty states, separate new-write and stored validation, unchanged historical canonical bytes and links, explicit unsupported declarations/binding, bounded agent receipts. Exact candidate passed focused99/0, strict Clippy, R2 Codex/Claude clean Medium+, and FULL12/12+3/3. Installed manifest recorded; broader E3 remains open.
